title: dns_cache Module
content_markdown: This module is an implementation of a cache system designed for DNS records. For successful DNS queries of all types, the module will store in a cache/db backend the mappings, for TTL number of seconds received in the DNS answer. Failed DNS queries will also be stored in the back-end, with a TTL that can be specified by the user. The module uses the Key-Value interface exported from the core.
overview: This module is an implementation of a cache system designed for DNS records. For successful DNS queries of all types, the module will store in a cache/db backend the mappings, for TTL number of seconds received in the DNS answer. Failed DNS queries will also be stored in the back-end, with a TTL that can be specified by the user. The module uses the Key-Value interface exported from the core.

dependencies_required.name: cachedb_*
dependencies_required.reason: Must be loaded before loading the dns_cache module to provide the key-value back-end.

exported_parameters.name: cachedb_url
exported_parameters.description: The url of the key-value back-end that will be used for storing the DNS records.
exported_parameters.example_code:
#use internal cachedb\_local module
modparam("dns\_cache", "cachedb\_url","local://")
#use cachedb\_memcached module with memcached server at 192.168.2.130
modparam("dns\_cache", "cachedb\_url","memcached://192.168.2.130:8888/")

exported_parameters.name: blacklist_timeout
exported_parameters.description: The number of seconds that a failed DNS query will be kept in cache. Default is 3600.

exported_parameters.name: min_ttl
exported_parameters.description: The minimum number of seconds that a DNS record will be kept in cache. If the TTL received in the DNS answer is lower than this value, the record will be cached for min_ttl seconds. _Default value is **0** seconds (no minimum TTL is enforced)._

configuration_examples.title: Set `cachedb_url` parameter
configuration_examples.description: Demonstrates setting the `cachedb_url` parameter to use either the internal cachedb_local module or a cachedb_memcached module.
configuration_examples.code:
...
#use internal cachedb_local module
modparam("dns_cache", "cachedb_url","local://")
#use cachedb_memcached module with memcached server at 192.168.2.130
modparam("dns_cache", "cachedb_url","memcached://192.168.2.130:8888/")
...

configuration_examples.title: Set `blacklist_timeout` parameter
configuration_examples.description: Demonstrates setting the `blacklist_timeout` parameter to 7200 seconds.

configuration_examples.title: Set `min_ttl` parameter
configuration_examples.description: Demonstrates setting the `min_ttl` parameter to 300 seconds.
